title: Network Theory Of Reality
definition: The view that reality is a complex network of interconnected entities.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Everything is connected, like a spider's web. What happens to one affects another.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Reality is a complex system of interrelated parts. Everything has an impact on everything else, and changes ripple through the system.
difficulty_levels.expert: Reality is a complex network characterized by emergent properties, nonlinearity, and feedback loops. The study of complex systems can reveal insights about the nature of reality and consciousness.
